# Blackstone Digital Infrastructure Trust Stock Jumps on Data-Center Deal With Amazon

Shares in Blackstone Digital Infrastructure Trust jumped 9% premarket after it agreed to buy a majority stake in a data-center portfolio from Amazon. com. 

Under the deal, the data-center focused REIT would acquire a 75% interest in two joint ventures with Amazon Web Services, which would retain a 25% stake.

noticias.titulo: Blackstone’s BXDC Buys 75% of Amazon Data Centers
noticias.resumo:
### Key Takeaways

 Blackstone Digital Infrastructure Trust took a 75% majority in two joint ventures with AWS covering 13 newly built powered shells in northern Indiana and Mississippi, valued at roughly $5 billion. 
 AWS keeps 25% and leases back the whole portfolio for 12 years, extendable to 32, while the venture has a debt commitment for 50% of the price at close. 
 BXDC says the deal is a template for buying stabilized, hyperscaler-leased data centers, a market it sizes at $1 trillion over five years.

Nvidia's stock-market troubles are spreading across Asia, sending some of the region's biggest AI winners tumbling ahead of the chip giant's earnings. 

On Monday, South Korea's benchmark Kospi index fell 3% as heavyweights Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix tumbled as much as 5% and 6%, respectively. 

Taiwan's Taiex dropped 5%, with Nvidia's key chipmaking partner TSMC down 4%.
